correctness.rationale: The universal-line coefficient equations give the exact Grassmannian local ring. They form a height-three regular sequence, with reduced scroll support. Explicit local elimination gives the dual-numbers chart, and Cohen–Macaulay unmixedness prevents hidden nilpotent or embedded components. Gorenstein adjunction, canonical module identification and cohomology prove the full carpet claim. The local Hilbert–Samuel multiplicity eight follows from the exact tangent cone complete-intersection degree. The standalone checker verifies the algebra in characteristics zero, two, three, five, seven and Hilbert coefficients; the general proof is not based on finite tests.

value.rationale: This calculates an intrinsic complete local singularity model of a classical line Fano scheme at a geometrically distinguished point. The nonreduced projectivized tangent cone is the canonical K3 carpet and has precise nilradical, canonical properties and degree-eight multiplicity. The result connects two natural previously separate geometric constructions, beyond computing a tangent-space dimension; scope is focused and limitations explicit.
